explication: lazy.nvim is a Neovim plugin manager. The principal workflow is: a user configures the manager, plugin specifications are resolved, missing plugins are fetched or installed, and Neovim loads them on startup or matching events, commands, filetypes, and keys. Management also covers locking, updates, SemVer, dependencies, local development, and async execution. UI, profiling, statusline, helptag generation, package sources, and colorscheme loading are supporting branches. No source excerpts were provided, so relationships are limited to documented product behavior.
